_comment: The bundled library, listed on Torchbearer's title screen. id / name / type / description are asserted against each pack's own `pack` block by test/smoke.mjs, so this file cannot drift from the JSON it describes. To add a pack: drop the .json in this folder and add an entry here. What a pack actually contains is counted from the pack itself on the load confirmation, not written down twice.

packs.name: The Long Vigil at Thornwake Bridge
packs.description: A level 3 one-shot: two mercenary companies have refought the same five minutes on a haunted bridge for fifty years. A skill-driven investigation opens a genuine third option — end the vigil with a blade, or end it by finally being believed.

packs.name: Embers of the Hold (Sample Expansion)
packs.description: A worked example of every pack collection: the orc ancestry, a background, shared feats, a new spell, a monster, a companion, and a two-battle mini-adventure.
